name: NumPy 2.0 C-Extension ABI Breaking Change
errorSignature: ValueError: numpy.dtype size changed, may indicate binary incompatibility. Expected 96 from C header, got 88 from PyObject
reproductionScript:
import sys
expected_c_header_size = 96
actual_pyobject_size = 88
if expected_c_header_size != actual_pyobject_size:
    sys.stderr.write('ValueError: numpy.dtype size changed, may indicate binary incompatibility. Expected 96 from C header, got 88 from PyObject\n')
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
groundTruthTestSuite:
def test_numpy_c_extension_abi():
    h = globals().get('c_header_size', 0)
    p = globals().get('pyobject_size', 0)
    assert h == 96 and p == 96, f'Binary ABI compatibility mismatch: header={h}, pyobject={p}'
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
test_numpy_c_extension_abi()

name: PostgreSQL 17 pg_dump transaction_timeout Incompatibility
reproductionScript:
import sys
server_version = 16
dump_line = 'SET transaction_timeout = 0;'
if 'transaction_timeout' in dump_line and server_version < 17:
    sys.stderr.write("psql:dump.sql:12: ERROR: unrecognized configuration parameter 'transaction_timeout'\n")
    sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)
groundTruthTestSuite:
def test_pg_dump_compatibility():
    params = globals().get('safe_params', [])
    for p in params:
        assert 'transaction_timeout' not in p, 'Incompatible transaction_timeout must not be emitted to PG16 targets'
    assert len(params) > 0, 'Parameters must be provided'
    print('ALL TESTS PASSED')
test_pg_dump_compatibility()
